interpretation: 186 previous gene/species panel entries leave and 186 different entries enter a full seeded redraw. The 14 overlapping gene/species entries retain exactly the old protein. This is not evidence that 186 prior sequences required correction. Changed full-pool candidate membership/order and enforced eligibility alter seeded sample membership while quotas/cutoffs stay fixed.

length_and_correspondence_review.limits: Supported coding boundaries and native exact translation establish annotated CDS readiness, not experimental full length, domain preservation, functional equivalence, or expression. Shorter proteins and internal differences can reflect genuine isoforms or annotation differences. No domain database/pairwise structural audit was performed; retain the quantitative comparisons for review without inferring missing domains or inventing a cutoff.
length_and_correspondence_review.method: Continuous length ratios plus SequenceMatcher (autojunk=False, matching the legacy scorer) exact-block accounting against actual human designed reference, without any new exclusion threshold. Internal unmatched-residue count excludes unmatched terminal human sequence; not a domain annotation.
